operating_notes.text: Reversed ₹40.73 Cr accrued wheeling and transmission liabilities following a favorable MERC order.
CTO received for production at Dahej (first phase) and commercial delivery started.
Dahej site (Site 4) covers 116 acres with <20% current land occupancy.
Commissioned Ethyl Acetate plant at Site-III (Lote Parshuram, Maharashtra) and commenced commercial dispatches on 22 May 2026.
Logistic costs have doubled since the Middle East conflict started, accompanied by multiple surcharges.

timeline.summary: Laxmi Organic Industries Limited’s **Dr. Rajan Venkatesh (MD & CEO)** and **Mr. Harshvardhan Goenka (Interim CFO)** will host an Investor & Analyst Meet on May 22, 2026, at 14:00 IST to discuss Q4 FY26 performance.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹735.31 Cr (+3.6% YoY), net profit ₹21.55 Cr (-1.0% YoY).
Laxmi Organic presented its Q4 & FY26 investor presentation detailing first-phase CTO at Dahej and portfolio expansion plans.
Laxmi Organic Industries Limited hosted an Investor & Analyst Meet on May 22, 2026, at 11:30 IST to discuss Q4FY26 and FY26 performance, with recording available via provided link.
Laxmi Organic successfully commissioned its Ethyl Acetate plant at Manufacturing Site-III in Lote Parshuram and commenced commercial dispatches.
Laxmi Organic hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 22, 2026, discussing feedstock volatility and Dahej expansion timelines.
Investor & Analyst Meet scheduled for Friday, November 06, 2026 at 2:00 PM IST.
